degrees.sheetIntro: 2027 Student Handbook data. This degree has no sheet in the WSLSA 2027 Degree Guides workbook, so its pathway is put together from the Handbook's structure for 2537 and the WSLSA Law sequence used for the other double degrees. The Handbook lists your Arts major and minor without a session for each subject, so their slots are yours to fill. It is not an official WSU sequence.
